TWITTER_USERNAME.description: Twitter/X account username used for login

TWITTER_EMAIL.description: Email associated with the Twitter/X account (used during login and verification)

TWITTER_DRY_RUN.description: If true, enables testing mode where tweets are not actually posted

MAX_TWEET_LENGTH.description: Maximum character length allowed for generated tweets

TWITTER_SEARCH_ENABLE.description: Toggle to enable or disable the search functionality

TWITTER_RETRY_LIMIT.description: Number of login retry attempts before giving up

TWITTER_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Interval (in seconds) between polling cycles for new interactions or tasks

TWITTER_TARGET_USERS.description: Comma-separated list of Twitter/X usernames to target for interactions

TWITTER_ENABLE_POST_GENERATION.description: Master switch to enable or disable automatic tweet generation

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_MIN.description: Minimum interval (in minutes) between automatically generated posts

TWITTER_POST_POST_INTERVAL_MAX.description: Maximum interval (in minutes) between automatically generated posts

TWITTER_POST_IMMEDIATELY.description: If true, generated tweets bypass the approval workflow and are posted immediately

ENABLE_ACTION_PROCESSING.description: Enables processing of queued actions such as mentions or DMs

MAX_ACTIONS_PROCESSING.description: Maximum number of actions that can be processed concurrently

TWITTER_SPACES_ENABLE.description: Enables Twitter Spaces creation and management features

ELEVENLABS_XI_API_KEY.description: API key for ElevenLabs, required when using Text-to-Speech in Twitter Spaces

TWITTER_APPROVAL_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord bot token used for the tweet approval workflow

TWITTER_APPROVAL_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID.description: Discord channel ID where generated tweets are sent for approval

TWITTER_APPROVAL_CHECK_INTERVAL.description: Interval (in milliseconds) between checks for approval reactions in Discord

TWITTER_COOKIES_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Existing Twitter auth_token cookie value used to skip the login flow if provided.

TWITTER_COOKIES_CT0.description: Existing Twitter ct0 cookie value used to skip the login flow if provided.

TWITTER_COOKIES_GUEST_ID.description: Existing Twitter guest_id cookie value used to skip the login flow if provided.

MAX_RETRIES.description: Maximum number of retries allowed for the Twitter login process before failing.

PROXY_URL.description: HTTP(s) proxy URL to route requests through (necessary when running the client in certain browser environments).

TWITTER_API_KEY.description: Twitter API v2 key used for enhanced functionality such as creating polls via the official API.

TWITTER_API_SECRET_KEY.description: Twitter API v2 secret corresponding to TWITTER_API_KEY.

TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Twitter API v2 access token used to authorize requests for tweet and poll functionality.

TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Secret associated with TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN for authenticating Twitter API v2 requests.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key supplied to SttTtsPlugin for GPT-based interactions.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: Primary ElevenLabs TTS API key supplied to SttTtsPlugin; if absent, ELEVENLABS_XI_API_KEY is used instead.
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.default: Falls back to ELEVENLABS_XI_API_KEY when not provided

TWITTER_COOKIES.description: Serialized cookie string used for cookie-based session authentication; if undefined and cookie file is missing, the code falls back to password auth.

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_MAX.description: Maximum delay, in minutes, between automatically generated posts.

TWITTER_INTERACTION_ENABLE.description: Determines whether mentions and interaction handling are enabled; only disabled when explicitly set to false.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_ENABLE.description: Enables timeline caching and handling logic for the Twitter client.

TWITTER_API_SECRET.description: Twitter API secret key for alternative API-based authentication.

TWITTER_ENABLE_ACTION_PROCESSING.description: Enable or disable processing of queued Twitter actions.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_MODE.description: Determines which Twitter timeline the client should fetch (e.g., 'following' or 'foryou').

TWITTER_TIMELINE_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Interval in seconds between polls of the Twitter timeline.
